description: Only what nothing else updates: extensions and skins pinned to a release tag in Dockerfile-mediawiki (REL1_46 and main clones already follow their branch on the weekly rebuild), phpredis, which is built from a GitHub tag because PECL went down during an urgent rebuild, the Falco images, and MariaDB and Redis, which are pinned by digest so a deploy only restarts them when a bump is merged. Other images stay managed by hand.

packageRules.description: Stay on the MariaDB 11.8 LTS series. A move to a newer series is a database upgrade to plan, not a routine bump.
phpredis tags its release candidates 6.3.0RC1 and so on. Only offer final releases.
Batch non-major GitHub Actions updates into one PR
